title: Jennifer Lopez brings her Las Vegas show to television this Thanksgiving
summary: CBS and Paramount+ have released the first trailer for The JLO Show.
body:
Jennifer Lopez's Las Vegas residency is coming to television. CBS and Paramount+ have released the first trailer and pictures for The JLO Show: Live in Las Vegas.

The two-hour concert special will be shown on CBS on Thanksgiving evening, Thursday 26 November, from 8 p.m., and will also stream on Paramount+.

What to expect

The special was filmed during Lopez's residency in Las Vegas and features the singer and actress performing hits from across her career.

Sources: Paramount Press Express, Yahoo Entertainment, Hola.
